scenes.title: Companion Memory for Pebble
scenes.caption: Your AI remembers, because it's yours.
scenes.narration: Your Companion Memory, on your wrist.

scenes.title: The watch never touches the network.
scenes.caption: It asks your phone. Your phone asks the Memory you host.
scenes.narration: The watch talks only to your phone. The phone makes one authenticated call to the Memory you host.

scenes.caption: Recall is one press. Ask offers questions, or dictation.
scenes.narration: Recall is one press. Ask offers a list of questions, or you can speak your own on watches with a microphone.

items.alt: Main menu with Recall, Ask and Last answer.
The Ask list, starting with Speak, Use dictation.

scenes.caption: Answers come back as short lines. Errors state the fix.
scenes.narration: The answer comes back as short lines, with a buzz. When something fails, the watch states the fact and the fix.

items.alt: An answer shown as short lines of saved memory.
An error reading: Key rejected. Paste it again in settings.

scenes.caption: One app on all five Pebble platforms.
scenes.narration: The same app runs on Aplite, Basalt, Chalk, Diorite and Emery.

items.alt: Answer on Aplite, black and white.

scenes.title: What stays on the watch, and what does not.
scenes.caption: Last answer is saved on the watch. Location sync is off until you turn it on.
scenes.narration: Your last answer stays on the watch, so it is there offline. Location sync is off until you turn it on, and there is no analytics.
